mechanism: St. John's Wort induces CYP3A4 and may reduce nitrofurantoin metabolism, though nitrofurantoin has limited hepatic metabolism; potential for reduced efficacy of either agent depending on individual enzyme activity.
action: Monitor clinical efficacy of nitrofurantoin for UTI treatment; consider alternative antimicrobial if treatment failure occurs, and counsel patient on St. John's Wort interactions with multiple drug classes.
